title: Last-Iterate Performance of Gradient Descent and Relaxed Proximal Point via $s$-Composability
summary: The notion of s-composability was introduced to compose optimized stepsize schedules while preserving sharp guarantees. We show that the same joint potential has a second use: it can serve directly as a certificate of sharp last-iterate performance. We develop this viewpoint for constant and silver schedules. For the constant schedule, we prove the s-composability statement posed as an open question by Grimmer et al.
